parts.text: Which labelling of the root systems is correct?

options.text: Carrot has a taproot system; maize has a fibrous root system.
Carrot has a fibrous root system; maize has a taproot system.
Both plants have taproot systems because both were dug from the garden.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Charu digs up a carrot plant and a maize plant from the school garden. The carrot plant has one thick main root with thinner side roots. The maize plant has many thin roots of nearly the same size and no single main root.

part_answers.answer: One thick main root with thinner side roots is a taproot (carrot); many similar thin roots with no main root are fibrous (maize).

teacher.key_rationale: Taproot: one main root with side roots. Fibrous: many similar thin roots. Swapping the labels reverses the relationship; merely being dug from the garden does not decide the type.
